tool_args.rationale: The pilot samples only horizons near the target, with u_past proportional to u_now and mem_conv proportional to x_now. An extra trajectory batch can distinguish transient dynamics before committing to a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coarse adiabatic slow ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows are consistent with an approximately linear steady state, but correlated inputs and damped transients leave the dynamics and their forecast errors insufficiently identified.
The pilot alone does not distinguish these stationary mechanisms reliably from the coarse slow-ODE approximation.
It is not relevant to resolving the dynamical ambiguity.
